title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named public-facing destinations in the Route 53, Airport Road, University Drive, Renwick Road, and Normantown Road corridors surrounding Lewis University.

cards.title: Lewis University Airport
cards.subtitle: Airport Road and Renwick Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the official airport information to orient yourself to this named off-campus aviation destination before planning any aviation-related visit.
cards.short_summary: A named airport beside the Lewis campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's Romeoville campus map lists Lewis University Airport as an off-campus destination accessed via Renwick Road.
cards.access_notes: Consult airport staff or the official airport site for visitor and operational access details.

cards.entity_name: National Weather Service Chicago Weather Forecast Office
cards.title: National Weather Service Chicago
cards.subtitle: George J. Michas Drive / University Drive corridor
cards.notes: Identify the large radar-dome site from public roads, then use its official forecasts and warnings when planning outdoor time.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Weather Service identifies its Chicago Weather Forecast Office as being in Romeoville at 250 George J. Michas Drive and describes its forecasting and warning mission.
cards.source_title: About the National Weather Service in Chicago
cards.access_notes: This is a working federal office; view it only from public areas unless an official program announces visitor access.

cards.title: Fitzpatrick House
cards.subtitle: Route 53 corridor
cards.notes: Locate this named university off-campus building from the Route 53 side and confirm any program or visitor access with its listed tenant.
cards.short_summary: A Lewis-owned off-campus building on Route 53.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's campus map lists Fitzpatrick House as an off-campus destination accessed via Route 53 and identifies Instituto Fe y Vida there.
cards.access_notes: Program and building access are not stated on the map; contact the listed organization before entering.

cards.title: Romeoville Athletic & Event Center
cards.subtitle: Route 53 / Phelps Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the center's current schedule for open-gym sessions, tournaments, clinics, or other public programming before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: An indoor sports and event complex on the Route 53 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village of Romeoville describes the Athletic & Event Center at 55 Phelps Avenue as a 99,000-square-foot indoor athletic and event complex and notes it is along the Route 53 corridor.
cards.source_title: Romeoville Athletic & Event Center — About Us
cards.access_notes: Facility and open-gym availability depend on scheduling; the Village lists building hours on its page.

cards.entity_name: White Oak Library District Romeoville Branch
cards.title: White Oak Library District Romeoville Branch
cards.subtitle: Normantown Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring a study task, browse the teen or adult areas, or ask staff about public computers and meeting-room availability.
cards.short_summary: A full-service public library branch with study-oriented spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: White Oak Library District says its Romeoville Branch at 201 W. Normantown Road has adult, children's and teen spaces, public computers, a teaching lab, quiet reading room, and meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: White Oak Library District — Romeoville Branch
cards.access_notes: The library publishes branch hours; some services, borrowing, and rooms may have eligibility or reservation rules.

cards.title: Romeoville Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Romeo Road / Route 53 corridor
cards.notes: Review the Village recreation schedule for classes, programs, or facility options that match the day you intend to visit.
cards.short_summary: A Village recreation destination on Romeo Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Romeoville's official parks and trails map identifies the Romeoville Recreation Center at 900 W. Romeo Road.
cards.source_title: Village of Romeoville Parks and Trails Map
cards.access_notes: Check current Village recreation programming and registration requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Romeoville Aquatic Center
cards.subtitle: Townhall Drive / Route 53 corridor
cards.notes: Use the Village's current recreation information to check seasonal operations, swim sessions, and admission requirements before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named municipal aquatic facility near the Route 53 network.
cards.evidence_claim: Romeoville's official parks and trails map identifies the Romeoville Aquatic Center at 630 Townhall Drive.
cards.source_title: Village of Romeoville Parks and Trails Map
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operations and entry requirements are not stated on the map; verify with Village recreation staff.

cards.title: Prairie Bluff Preserve
cards.subtitle: Renwick Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose the paved trail for a walk, run, or bike ride, and plan to finish before the preserve's posted sunset closing.
cards.short_summary: A large wetland preserve with a paved multi-use trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Forest Preserve District of Will County says Prairie Bluff Preserve is on Renwick Road east of Weber Road and has 3.21 miles of paved trail for several outdoor activities.
cards.source_title: Forest Preserve District of Will County — Prairie Bluff Preserve
cards.access_notes: The Forest Preserve District lists hours as 8 a.m. to sunset daily except Christmas.

cards.title: Prairie Bluff Public Golf Club
cards.subtitle: Renwick Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the club's current booking information if you want to plan a round or use its dining and event facilities along Renwick Road.
cards.short_summary: An 18-hole public golf destination on Renwick Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Prairie Bluff Public Golf Club identifies itself at 19433 Renwick Road in Crest Hill, and the Lockport Township Park District describes it as an 18-hole course.
cards.access_notes: Tee times, dining, and event access may require reservations or purchase; verify directly with the club.

cards.title: St. Charles Borromeo North Campus
cards.subtitle: Airport Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the campus map to identify the chapel, gallery, Flight Deck, Innovation Hub, and other named spaces before arranging a campus visit.
cards.short_summary: A Lewis destination accessed from Airport Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Lewis University's Romeoville campus map identifies St. Charles Borromeo North Campus as accessed via 101 Airport Road and lists its named facilities.
cards.access_notes: This is university property; confirm access for individual spaces with Lewis University before visiting.
